entries.text: 我也经常疯狂伤害别人。我就是一个大头针！操的，我是一个神！一个被王八操过的牛逼神！但那还不够！我还是一个迈着企鹅步伐的战斗机器！不过现在，我是……我是……救救我……

entries.text: 你知道吗？夜行团说他是个比他们还丑的丑八怪。那就是说着他必须要成为一个超级杂种丑八怪。

entries.text: 他是一个人！一个有计划的人！他爱我们所以制定了许多计划！而且如果这个世界与他的方式合拍，操他！这一切都是那爱带来的！

entries.text: Do you want to die? I can put you out of your misery.

entries.text: You sound stupid!

entries.text: Love is what makes the cactus grow! Love is what makes the brahmin moo! Love is screwing, #it's screwing your life! I hate love! I love hate! If the Master hated us, we'd be all right!
entries.source_text: Love is what makes the cactus grow! Love is what makes the brahmin moo! Love is screwing, #it's screwing your life! I hate love! I love hate! If the Master hated us, we'd be all right!

entries.text: Where is your conscience, man? Do you think that life's supposed to be some pretty picture #without any misery in it? Life IS misery! Misery, and whatever the Hell we decide to do about it!
entries.source_text: Where is your conscience, man? Do you think that life's supposed to be some pretty picture #without any misery in it? Life IS misery! Misery, and whatever the Hell we decide to do about it!

entries.text: Coping! Loving! Screwing! Hating! Taking chances! Boring people! Bashing assholes! Making #friends with other assholes! Running away from your mistakes! Facing your mistakes! Radiation!
entries.source_text: Coping! Loving! Screwing! Hating! Taking chances! Boring people! Bashing assholes! Making #friends with other assholes! Running away from your mistakes! Facing your mistakes! Radiation!

entries.text: Having kids and doing the same thing over again, sometimes better, sometimes worse!
entries.source_text: Having kids and doing the same thing over again, sometimes better, sometimes worse!

entries.text: That is life, man! It's like being drunk; look at it one way, and it's a piss poor #embarrassment! Look at it a different way and it feels great! But it's all the same thing! It's all #life!
entries.source_text: That is life, man! It's like being drunk; look at it one way, and it's a piss poor #embarrassment! Look at it a different way and it feels great! But it's all the same thing! It's all #life!

entries.text: Ah ha! Ha! Ha! Ha! Ha! You're right! We're all stupid! Don't you get it? Ha! Ha! Ha!
entries.source_text: Ah ha! Ha! Ha! Ha! Ha! You're right! We're all stupid! Don't you get it? Ha! Ha! Ha!

entries.text: I'm a little bitter right now. Like Orange Pekoe left out in the rain. Ha! I like that #saying! I think I'll keep repeating it! I'm a little bitter right now. Like Orange Pekoe left out in #the rain . . .
